statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: src-app/routes/__root.tsx, src-app/styles/globals.css, src-app/**/*.test.ts, src-app/**/*.test.tsx. Do not edit forbidden paths: package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, src-tauri/**, src-app/stores/**, src-app/schemas/**, src-app/routes/(settings)/**.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.
